phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَيَجَـانِ الْحِرْصِ ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, I seek refuge in You from the agitation of craving,

phrases.arabic: وَسَوْرَةِ الغَضَبِ وَغَلَبَةِ الْحَسَدِ وضَعْفِ الصَّبْرِ
phrases.english: 2.the violence of wrath, the domination of envy, the frailty of patience,

phrases.arabic: وَقِلَّةِ الْقَنَاعَةِ وَشَكَاسَةِ الْخُلُقِ ،
phrases.english: 3.the lack of contentment, surliness of character,

phrases.arabic: وَإلْحَاحِ الشَّهْوَةِ ، وَمَلَكَةِ الْحَمِيَّةِ ،
phrases.english: 4.urgency of passion, the disposition to vehemence,

phrases.arabic: وَمُتَابَعَةِ الْهَوَى ، وَمُخَالَفَةِ الْهُدَى ،
phrases.english: 5.following caprice, opposing guidance,

phrases.arabic: وَسِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ ، وَتَعَاطِي الْكُلْفَةِ ،
phrases.english: 6.the sleep of heedlessness, undertaking the toilsome,

phrases.arabic: وَإيْثَارِ الْبَاطِلِ عَلَى الْحَقِّ وَالإصْرَارِ عَلَى الْمَأثَمِ ،
phrases.english: 7.preferring falsehood over truth, persisting in sin,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتِصْغَـارِ الْمَعْصِيَـةِ ، وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الطَّاعَةِ ،
phrases.english: 8.making little of disobedience, making much of obedience,

phrases.arabic: وَمُبَاهَاةِ الْمُكْثِرِينَ ، وَالإزْرآءِ بِالْمُقِلِّينَ ،
phrases.english: 9.vying with the wealthy, distitleging the poor,

phrases.arabic: وَسُوءِ الْوِلاَيَةِ لِمَنْ تَحْتَ أَيْدِينَا
phrases.english: 10.guarding badly over those in our hands,

phrases.arabic: وَتَرْكِ الشُّكْرِ لِمَنِ اصْطَنَعَ الْعَارِفَةَ عِنْدَنَا ،
phrases.english: 11.failing to thank those who have done good to us,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ نَعْضُدَ ظَالِماً ، أَوْ نَخْذُلَ مَلْهُوفاً ،
phrases.english: 12.aiding a wrongdoer, abandoning someone troubled,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ نَرُومَ مَا لَيْسَ لَنَا بِحَقّ،
phrases.english: 13.wanting what is not rightfully ours,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ نَقُولَ فِي الْعِلْمِْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْم
phrases.english: 14.and speaking about knowledge without knowing.

phrases.arabic: وَنَعُـوذُ بِـكَ أَنْ نَنْطَوِيَ عَلَى غِشِّ أَحَد ،
phrases.english: 15.We seek refuge in You from harbouring dishonesty toward anyone,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ نُعْجَبَ بِأَعْمَالِنَا ، وَنَمُدَّ فِي آمَالِنَا ،
phrases.english: 16.being pleased with our works, and stretching out our expectations.

phrases.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ السَّرِيرَةِ ، وَاحْتِقَارِ الصَّغِيرَةِ ،
phrases.english: 17.We seek refuge in You from ill-mindedness, looking down on the small,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ يَسْتَحْوِذَ عَلَيْنَا الشَّيْطَانُ ،
phrases.english: 18.Satan's gaining mastery over us,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ يَنْكُبَنَـا الزَّمَانُ ، أَوْ يَتَهَضَّمَنَا السُّلْطَانُ.
phrases.english: 19.time's afflicting us, and the sovereign's oppressing us.

phrases.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ تَنَاوُلِ الإسْرَافِ ، وَمِنْ فِقْدَانِ الْكَفَـافِ
phrases.english: 20.We seek refuge in You from acting with prodigality and not having sufficiency.

phrases.arabic: وَنَعُوذُ بِـكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنَ الْفَقْرِ إلَى الاَكْفَاءِ
phrases.english: 21.We seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, indigent need for equals,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ مَعِيشَة فِي شِدَّة وَمَيْتَة عَلَى غَيْـرِ عُدَّة.
phrases.english: 22.living in hardship, and dying without readiness.

phrases.arabic: وَنَعُـوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْحَسْرَةِ الْعُظْمى ،
phrases.english: 23.We seek refuge in You from the most dreadful remorse,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمُصِيبَةِ الْكُبْرَى ، وَأَشْقَى الشَّقَآءِ وَسُوءِ المآبِ ،
phrases.english: 24.the greatest affliction, the most wretched wretchedness, the evil end to the journey,

phrases.arabic: وَحِرْمَانِ الثَّوَابِ ، وَحُلُولِ الْعِقَابِ.
phrases.english: 25.the deprivation of reward, and the advent of punishment.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،
phrases.english: 26.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَلِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
phrases.english: 27.and through Your mercy, give to me refuge from all of that,

phrases.arabic: وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
phrases.english: 28.and to all the faithful, both men and women!

phrases.arabic: يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
phrases.english: 29.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
